[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Teru''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirtania]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Teru offered a reward of 3,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the live capture of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[T'Jaleq Kith'Araquia]].
